thread:
maria-sec: Heads up — customer ACME asked for SIEM enrichment: they want namespace/tenant mapping fields in audit events and a stable obfuscated tenant_id for SIEM correlation. Need guidance on schema, delivery options (webhook vs S3), and onboarding validation.

devon-infra: +1. Two-part Q: 1) field names and versioning plan so we don't break Splunk props/transforms; 2) surface KMS key used for S3 exports in object metadata/headers.

ali-pm: Goal is correlation across services without exposing real tenant IDs. Proposal: add top-level fields `tenant_namespace` and `tenant_id_hash_v1`. Keep existing `tenant` field but mark deprecated.

maria-sec: Proposed event sample (JSON):
```json
{
  "event_version": "audit.events.v2",
  "ts": "2026-03-15T18:12:30Z",
  "actor": {"id": "u_123", "type": "user"},
  "action": "model.deploy",
  "resource": {"type": "deployment", "id": "d_789", "namespace": "acme-prod"},
  "tenant_namespace": "acme",
  "tenant_id_hash_v1": "sha256:e3b0c44298fc1...",
  "tenant_id_hash_alg": "sha256-v1",
  "delivery": {
    "method": "s3",
    "s3": {
      "bucket": "redwood-audit-acme",
      "object_key": "2026/03/15/18/evt1.json",
      "kms_key_id": "arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123:key/abcd-ef01"
    }
  }
}
```

jess-cs: For onboarding we can provide a tiny validation script customers run against exports. Example jq filter: `jq 'select(.tenant_namespace and .tenant_id_hash_v1)' *.json` — fails if required fields missing.

devon-infra: For Splunk, recommend flat fields (avoid deep nesting) so props/transforms stay simple. Also add S3 object metadata/top-level headers: `X-Redwood-Audit-Version`, `X-Redwood-Tenant-Hash`, `X-Redwood-KMS-KeyId`. For webhooks include `X-Redwood-Signature` and `X-Redwood-Delivery-Method`.

sam-sre: Quick question — do we plan to rotate tenant_id_hash algorithm? If yes, include `tenant_id_hash_alg` so downstream parsers can handle multiple versions.

maria-sec: Agreed — include `tenant_id_hash_alg` and bump `event_version` if algo or semantics change. Validators accept v1 and v2. Maintain a compatibility table in docs.

ali-pm: Customer-facing validation: propose a /audit/validate endpoint that accepts sample events and returns pass/fail + list of missing fields. For S3 customers we can provide a tiny Lambda that reads object metadata and runs the same validator.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Validation harness v1 deployed to staging — tests: schema check, required fields, header validation. :white_check_mark:

jess-cs: For Datadog, customers should parse JSON logs and map `tenant_namespace` to a tag, `tenant_id_hash_v1` to an attribute. Also a docs callout: DO NOT put raw emails/PII into `actor` or freeform message fields.

maria-sec: Action items: devon add headers & S3 envelope metadata; eng-runtime add `tenant_id_hash_alg` and `X-Redwood-Audit-Version` header; docs/jess publish onboarding validation snippet + Lambda quickstart. I'll draft PR description with sample payloads.

devon-infra: I'll draft the S3 envelope + webhook header PR and include sample Splunk props/transforms lines.

jess-cs: I'll draft onboarding email and quickstart with jq and Datadog pipeline examples.

sam-sre: +1. If we can run a small test dataset through Splunk/Datadog SIEM pipelines that'd be helpful — I can coordinate a pilot.

maria-sec: Thanks all — tagging @ali-pm for prioritization and timelines. :eyes:
